name: Aryt Industries
summary: Aryt Industries Ltd., through its subsidiaries, develops, produces, and markets electronic fuses in Israel. It engages in the production of trigger systems for fuses; and provision of subcontracting services. The company serves defense customers. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Ranly Investments Limited and changed its name to Aryt Industries Ltd. in June 1992. Aryt Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Or Yehuda, Israel.
